spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude, no manufacturer model read: VTO = VGS(th) max (no typical given; the worst case for switching on), KP so that RDS(on) is 0.20 Ω at VGS 10 V with RD = 0 (one data point: the split between channel and RD is not known); body diode IS left at the simulator default – the datasheet gives VSD only as 1.3 V max at 5.7 A
LCSC product data C2598 (2026-10-31): Infineon IRF520NPBF, TO-220AB, 181 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 203 pcs
notes: Standard-level N-channel MOSFET (RDS(on) specified only at VGS 10 V) – the counter-example of maker-coverage CK-4: on the common 'IRF520 module' driven from a 5 V or 3.3 V GPIO it is half on or off; LIM.range/gate reports any |VGS| between 2.0 V and 10 V. The Vishay IRF520PBF (C2597, 0.27 Ω at 10 V) is the older part of the same name; this is the IR/Infineon IRF520N. Library draft.
